purpose: Does holding a signalled stock for 5 trading days (instead of closing it the same day) show a net edge on an Alpaca-like universe? Historical, daily bars only, local, long-only.
data: Daily bars (SIP) already downloaded by research/round2 step1 for the whole pool incl. delisted symbols, 2020-11-02..2023-12-29. No new downloads in the development phase.

periods.rule: The locked period is not downloaded or analysed unless a hypothesis passes development (gated in code).

universe.advDefinition: mean(close*volume) of the 20 sessions ending at signal day t
universe.pickBy: mean((high-low)/close) over the 20 sessions ending at t (highest first)

execution.exitPrimary: close of day t+5 (five sessions held)
execution.stop: none (daily bars cannot prove intraday stop order); a separate descriptive line reports a -1 x ATR-free worst-case via the worst single trade
execution.missingBars: if any session t+1..t+5 is missing or more than 10 calendar days away, the trade is censored and counted

costs.note: 0.15% per side primary; Alpaca measured average slippage was +0.13% in the live paper arm.

M1.name: continuation after a strong volume day
M1.rule: return(t) >= +8%, volume(t) >= 2 x mean volume of the previous 20 sessions, close in the top quarter of the day's range

M2.name: short-term reversal after a sharp drop
M2.rule: return(t) <= -8%, volume(t) >= 2 x mean volume of the previous 20 sessions

M3.name: 20-day high breakout
M3.rule: close(t) > max high of the previous 20 sessions, volume(t) >= 1.5 x mean volume of the previous 20 sessions, return(t) >= +3%

control: per day, up to 5 random stocks from the same top-150 universe (seeded sha256 order), same entry and exit

inference.statistic: mean over dates of (picks mean net return - control mean net return), dates with both groups
inference.test: date-block circular bootstrap, blocks of 20 dates, 2000 resamples, one-sided p for mean <= 0
inference.passRule: Holm p < 0.05 AND excess > 0 AND absolute net mean > 0 AND at least 100 trades AND at least 2 of 3 calendar years with positive net mean

report: max drawdown of the per-date mean curve
concentration of profit in the best 5% of dates
share of entries with an opening gap above +10% vs the signal close
noTuning: Thresholds, horizon and costs above are fixed now. No threshold is varied after seeing results.
